ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 22672, February 22, 2011>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) Part of the Decree on the Defense Intelligence Headquarters shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3 (2), "Force Development Headquarters" shall be replaced with "Military Support Headquarters."
(2) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 13 (1) 2 (b), "Head of Joint Operations Headquarters, Head of Strategic Planning Headquarters, and Head of Force Development Headquarters" shall be replaced with "Head of Operations Headquarters, Head of Strategic Planning Headquarters, and Head of Military Support Headquarters."
Article 3 (Relationship with Other Statutes) Where other statutes cite the former Decree on the Organization of the Joint Chiefs of Staff or its provisions and corresponding provisions exist in this Decree, they shall be deemed to cite this Decree or its corresponding provisions.
